book.name: Apasoro
book.title: APASORO NAU MUMAWA Siosi Amatonewa Gaiyawa

content: Keptete Arawa Perikus Namive

Sira oiyat 5 onananeve, pirisi painauvitwa Ananias me iyayapan namuyoiyoi igiyawa ge papara aivi abnawa iviwa Teruturas gaibu Sesariya aig amiya. Meve mu namuyoiyoi abnawa kokawa namive Poru gumbe pui yuya.

Meve Poru auwaya unignewa Teruturas amatog pui yuwanne wane, “Kokawa numa Perikus, ge gungap nu degadega ete, ge ankwatagap yum oraimina auete, sira ge anoano oraiwa geuma gumbe at mame danave yaiyai oraimina biroriyaivi.
Nu dividivi oraiwa mame at ampa ampa danave yautu, meoya gaun ge gungap vete.
Gare ge gungap ne den ibnawa gentna, meoya ne gae pipi mame dirukna. Garawapa gae neuma anoa ebnotu geuma gumbe.
Apan mame me yuwat iviwa Pesto mina, sira Ju igiyawa mu piyu mame undag danave wakeemewa mu yapowo waivi mut darat waivi. Me namuyoiyoi abnawa Nasaret kuiya da danave.
Apan mame me temporu miyot miyot atan aivi, meoya nu me yumtune.
Apan koka numawa Perikus, ge gembovit dividivi mame yobag yawawa, ge matai yaug anoa divi oya nu me diyag vete.”
Ju igiyawa gaibu ung waya me anoano meuma oya, sira waya undag mame natawa di.

Meve amaraiviwa kokawa me Poru gumbe naniwa yune sira wane Poru gae watan oya. Meoya Poru garawa wane, “Ne anona apan koka numawa ge bairawan dadi iyayapan oya keptete ege abnawa, meoya ne degadega gumbe nembo oya papara vintna.
Ge yaiyai yobawa yaug anoa, ne God waiyatan oya Jerusarem dog anedna, sira me apa onnewa gare oiyat 12 mina onanaivi.
Sira bira da den yaunedne, temporu arawa danave, sinagogu danave, gwetoimu koka danave ne bira da gaibu diguragut etewa, sira iyayapan gaibu nu wayug wayug etewa.
Mu pui yunegemewa oya mu matai natawa da oma den ane toyau gempe.
Megara ne namugap taibe watna, epin me Ju igiyawa wayawa anotumat ugaugaeba gumbe ne isimuranaiwa God numawa waiyaeni. Dividivi undag me Gwangwan ge Propeta bukaeba danave tenewa ne anotumat eni.
Sira iyayapan mame gaibu anoeme mina, ne imug imug God gumbe anoeniwa, apan oraiwa ge apan kukaeba matai bo gumbe sira inaimutpe.
Meoya ne kum evedni oraivitwa neuma eni, God ge iyayapan namuwo mu pui den yunekpe.
Namu bairawan dadi onanane, ivi ne evenaiwa gumbo dividivi muntan oya ge puyo barautan oya sira taig onedna.
Puyo asime oya, nenan muinne sira ne temporu arawa danave unig wakenawa, mu ne yaunegiya. Megara iyayapan dadi den wakeya sira garawa den eme. Ju igiyawa upeba mu Esia apa onamiyawa mu mukut wakeya.
Mu anoano muma oya pui yunektan anoeme ipewa, mu namugap onam ne pui yunekpe di.
Go, iyayapan mu mapa wakeemewa kwemna wape divi kukaeba neuma yauyawa ne Daiboru Painauvitwa namive yoinawa kumiwa apa.
Ne yapowo yoinawa, ne divi desirom kwaruwanawa, ‘Ye gare mame pui yunegenewa boriruwayawa sira inaimut yoipe oya.’”
Megara Perikus Ebu mame oya anoano kokawa yaug anone, meoya me wane, “Mut namuyoiyoi abnawa kokawa Raisias aig ompewa, kukaeba yeuma mame waribiyata,” sira keptete kumiwa utuban barautan oya wane.
Meve me senturion
gumbe dig wanewa, Poru aug danave yangut yaiyai yavigimpe. Megara Poru ui onan kwepe wakeigimpe, meve owawaiwa oma ane Poru me amaraigimpe.
Oiyat upeba onanane, Perikus me biviwa Drusira me Ju vesinawa aug onne, sira Poru auwane. Meve me Keriso Iesu gumbe anotumat aiviwa gaiyawa wane anoya.
Megara Poru dirum wane oraiminawa ge numbo amat numawa ge pui yutanwa kumiwa oniviwa oya, meoya Perikus a ag wane, “Gare mame ge oma ane gwe sira taig aga. Kum da ne genan auwatna.”
Kum desirom me apa, me anoiviwa Poru gumbe anmagawa guwave aupe, meoya me Poru oya kum dada menan auwane me gaibu gae waya.
Bairawan duwam onananewa, Porukias Pestas me Perikus nau meuma aune. Megara Perikus imive Ju igiyawa degadega atan oya me Poru kwene nog dana ande wakene.
